{{Top}}
'''Otoh swirls''' were graceful, curved designs often found in [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] clothing, specifically items produced in [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]]. [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Nass's]] clothing had Otoh swirls.
